lines: [announcer] [fast] Cyber Monday: fifteen billion dollars. Spend it at a hundred a day.
[fast] A hundred a day. One year? Thirty-six thousand five hundred.
[confident] A whole lifetime of shopping? About three million.
[nervous] That's... two hundredths of one percent of one Cyber Monday.
[shocked] You'd need four hundred thirteen thousand years.
[deadpan] Humans have only existed for about three hundred thousand. You'd start shopping before people were invented.
[deadpan] Online, America does it in one day. A hundred seventy-five thousand dollars a second.
[whisper] So... spend fifteen billion. At a hundred a day.
